name: Veyle
title: Enchanter of the Focus House
examine: Old blood, whole: moonpale, upswept ears, an age nobody asks about twice. The Arcanum sent her away for a question. The seal on the Stair is older craft, and she means to read it.
lines: The seal on the Stair is older work than mine. That is not a small thing to say.
Solvei writes to me every month. The letters are very polite. So is my silence.
My people built the old realm's lights. I am only finishing the shift.
